name: Comparison
responsibility: Per scenario, per workflow and for the broad case: what moved between the arms, a mean held to the noise the batch measures in itself
description: A pass count is a tally and any change to it is real; a grader mean is held to the spread of the runs the two arms share, paired scenario for scenario (report-change.ts), and gets a word only where more than one scenario stands behind it. Author and grader usage are never added together.
